The electoral commission blamed 54 officials for fake records on the voter register, and armed men blocked Isa Pantami's convoy with burning tyres in Gombe. Neither story accounts for the betting.

stocks:MSFT.standing: Shares in the maker of Windows, Office and the Azure cloud, one of the world's most valuable companies. Its OpenAI stake and its data-centre spending make it a bellwether for whether the AI build-out pays.
stocks:MSFT.recent: Microsoft's own services failed: Outlook and Teams were disrupted for nearly a day, Downdetector logged 130,000 Outlook reports at the peak, and the shares fell 3% amid the disruptions. The same week a researcher leaked SignDrop, a Windows exploit that gives ordinary users System rights.

poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Israel-Iran ceasefire is still holding on 31 December. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on every strike, threat and report of talks.
poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.recent: Iran's Guard said mines hit four tankers in 24 hours, its drones went at a US radar at Isa air base in Bahrain, and a third US carrier reached the Gulf. The one step back came in Islamabad, where Iran cut its Hormuz reopening plan from 7 days to 2; none of this accounts for the climb in what traders will pay.

wiki-nvidia.standing: Nvidia, the Santa Clara chip designer whose graphics processors run most of the world's AI training, and one of the most valuable companies on earth. Its fortunes carry the chip sector and the data-centre build-out with them.
wiki-nvidia.recent: Jensen Huang quit Nvidia amid a spy scandal over Megaspeed, its Singapore cloud partner, which US investigators are probing for the possible diversion of AI chips to China. Colette Kress, finance chief since 2013, took over, and her first results showed $65.3 billion in profit and a $130 billion forecast.

wiki-petroleum.standing: Crude oil and the fuels refined from it: petrol, diesel, jet fuel and the feedstock for plastics. It supplies about a third of the world's energy, and its price runs through transport, food and inflation almost everywhere.
wiki-petroleum.recent: Houthi missiles fired towards Riyadh damaged Aramco Tower, and a day later Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline was struck. Brent still fell below $90 as Saudi Arabia reported output up 26% in October, and Iraq's Kirkuk-Ceyhan pipeline pumped crude to Turkey again after a decade.

poly-will-pete-hegseth-be-the-first-of-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the US House of Representatives impeaches Pete Hegseth, the defense secretary, before 2028. Impeachment takes only a simple House majority, so the price lives on who controls the chamber.
poly-will-pete-hegseth-be-the-first-of-t.recent: Nothing in the fortnight's reporting concerns Hegseth himself. The nearest it comes is the U.S. midterm election, which decided who holds the votes an impeachment needs, but none of the material reports that result or anything else that accounts for the price.

poly-iran-oman-hormuz-agreement-by-novem.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Iran and Oman, the two states on either shore of the Strait of Hormuz, reach an agreement on the strait by November 30. The price is what traders pay for a yes.
poly-iran-oman-hormuz-agreement-by-novem.recent: Talks and attacks pulled in opposite directions. In Islamabad, Iran shortened its plan for reopening Hormuz to 2 days. In the same days its army and Guard said mines struck 4 tankers in about 24 hours, a drone alarm sounded at an Iraqi gas field, Iranian drones hit Bahrain, and a third US carrier reached the Gulf.

stocks:UAL.standing: The parent of United Airlines, one of the three largest US carriers, with hubs in Chicago, Newark and San Francisco. Its shares move on jet fuel costs, business-travel demand and its transatlantic and Pacific routes.
stocks:UAL.recent: United's departures stalled for 90 minutes on Monday in a widespread system outage. Days earlier the airline barred AI agents such as OpenAI's dots from booking its flights, citing security concerns. Both came after the share's peak, and neither accounts for the climb before it.

stocks:BIDU.standing: China's largest search engine, whose New York-listed shares also price its bets on Ernie AI models, Kunlun chips and Apollo Go robotaxis.
stocks:BIDU.recent: The news about Baidu this fortnight was product news: a 1,024-chip Tianchi supernode it will sell next year, and a simulator that stands in for some of the 700,000km of road testing each robotaxi model iteration needs. Neither accounts for the share price.

stocks:SPCX.standing: The rocket and satellite company Elon Musk founded. It flies most of the world's orbital launches and runs Starlink, the largest satellite internet network, and its military Starshield variant makes it a defence contractor too.
stocks:SPCX.recent: The trough came as SpaceX's default risk hit a fresh peak in a tech-led selloff. Since then it has announced $74 billion in AI computing campuses, caught a Starship upper stage after 14 orbits, and faced a European Commission demand to lift Starshield limits that cut off Ukraine's drones above 161 km/h.

stocks:WHL.JO.standing: A Johannesburg-listed retailer that runs the Woolworths stores in South Africa, selling premium food, clothing and homeware, plus Country Road Group in Australia. Its food arm is a gauge of what the middle class still spends.
stocks:WHL.JO.recent: Woolworths reported that turnover at Woolworths Foods grew only 1.9% and concession sales just 0.1%. That is a sharp slowdown in the food business the group relies on to sell to South Africa's middle class, and the shares fell on the figures.

wiki-jensen-huang.standing: Co-founder of Nvidia, the chipmaker whose graphics processors became the hardware most AI models are trained on. He led it from its founding in 1993, and its rise made him one of the most closely watched executives in technology.
wiki-jensen-huang.recent: Nvidia investigated Huang over an affair with the head of Megaspeed, a Singapore firm now facing a criminal probe, amid a US-China spy scandal, and Sen. Cramer called on him to resign. He quit and finance chief Colette Kress took over; Trump has since backed a 177,000-signature petition to reinstate him.

stocks:PLTR.standing: Palantir sells software that pulls scattered records into one searchable picture, to armies, spy agencies, police forces and large companies. Government contracts are its core, so its fortunes follow public budgets and politics.
stocks:PLTR.recent: The one story about its business came from Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, where a Left coalition rejected Palantir for police work but still plans automated police data analysis with another tool. That is a single lost regional customer, and it does not account for the fall in the share price.

stocks:MBG.DE.standing: The Stuttgart carmaker behind Mercedes-Benz cars and vans, listed in Frankfurt. Its profits lean on wealthy buyers in China and on exports to the US, so Chinese demand and tariffs reach the share quickly.
stocks:MBG.DE.recent: Four months of talks in Germany ended with Mercedes-Benz halting investment in its home country, the one development here about the company's own business. It came on the last day of the window, so it does not explain the rise before it.

stocks:TSLA.standing: The Austin-based maker of electric cars and of batteries that store grid power, run by Elon Musk. Its share price carries bets on driverless taxis and robots worth far more than its car sales earn.
stocks:TSLA.recent: Tesla ended Cybertruck production after selling 11,586 in nine months, by Cox Automotive's estimate. The shares rose 4% that morning as investors bet that the steering-wheel-free Cybercab replaces it. Bloomberg has since reported that SpaceX and Tesla may announce a merger in December.

poly-us-strike-on-cuba-by-december-31.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States carries out a military strike on Cuba before its deadline. Its price is what traders stake on open conflict between Washington and Havana, 90 miles apart across the Florida Straits.

poly-will-the-reserve-bank-of-india-make.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Reserve Bank of India leaves its repo rate, the rate at which it lends to commercial banks, unchanged at its December meeting. That rate sets the cost of borrowing across India.
poly-will-the-reserve-bank-of-india-make.recent: Nothing in the fortnight's reporting concerns the RBI. The news ran on the Fed instead: hotter October US consumer prices, Logan and Musalem calling for more hikes, and the US dollar at a 19-month peak. None of it carries a decision or signal from the RBI itself.

stocks:BABA.standing: The Hangzhou group behind Taobao and Tmall, China's biggest online marketplaces, and the country's largest cloud computing business. These New York-listed shares trade on Chinese consumer spending and its bets on artificial intelligence.
stocks:BABA.recent: The fortnight's news from Alibaba was of expansion, not setback: its Qwen model became the AI behind Siri on Chinese iPhones, it said it would list its T-Head chip unit in Hong Kong while keeping control, and it launched an AI music app. None of it accounts for the fall in the share price.

poly-will-anthropics-market-cap-be-less-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, closes its first day of public trading worth less than $1.25 trillion. It is a wager on how the market will price one of the largest AI developers.

poly-iaea-visits-isfahan-fordow-or-natan.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if International Atomic Energy Agency inspectors visit an Iranian nuclear site by the year's end. Those inspections are the only outside check on how much enriched uranium Iran holds.
poly-iaea-visits-isfahan-fordow-or-natan.recent: Iran's Assembly of Experts urged leaving the nuclear treaty, Mehr reported, and the next day the UN watchdog called on Iran to reopen its facilities, having been unable to inspect sites since the US-Israeli attacks. Washington, without inspectors on the ground, offered up to $20 million to informants on Iran's nuclear program.

stocks:1024.HK.standing: Kuaishou runs China's second-largest short-video and live-streaming app after ByteDance's Douyin, and earns from advertising, live-stream tipping and e-commerce. Its shares follow Chinese ad spending and its contest with Douyin.
stocks:1024.HK.recent: Kuaishou's AI video unit Kling raised about 19.8 billion yuan in a round that valued it above its parent, and the share peaked straight after. Kuaishou has since doubled down on Kling, which earned over $20 million in December 2025 alone; nothing in the input explains the slide that followed.

poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-repub.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marco Rubio, the former Florida senator who became Trump's secretary of state, is the Republican presidential nominee in 2028. It prices him against the field to succeed Trump.
poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-repub.recent: The fortnight's news touching this market was about Polymarket itself: Trump Jr. left his advisory role at Kalshi after his firm invested $300 million in its rival. None of it concerns Rubio or the nomination race, and nothing in it accounts for the price.

stocks:300750.SZ.standing: The world's largest maker of electric-vehicle batteries, based in Ningde, Fujian, and listed in Shenzhen. Its cells go into cars from Tesla to BMW, so its share moves on Chinese EV sales, lithium prices and Western trade rules.

poly-ukraine-signs-peace-deal-with-russi.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine agree a peace deal before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, so it moves on talks, battlefield turns and Washington's diplomacy.
poly-ukraine-signs-peace-deal-with-russi.recent: Abu Dhabi hosted the first Russia-Ukraine peace talks in 9 months, but TASS reported that Putin was not ready to make peace there, and Zelensky said the US had raised a Donbas withdrawal in exchange for NATO. Within days Ukraine struck the Kerch bridge to Crimea and Russia hit bridges in Kyiv.

poly-will-chiang-wan-an-win-the-next-tai.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Chiang Wan-an, the Kuomintang mayor of Taipei, wins the city's next mayoral race. Taiwan's capital has twice sent its mayor on to the presidency, so the seat is read as a test of the parties' national strength.

poly-us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-by-no.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States and Iran reach an effective ceasefire before its deadline. Its price is what traders will pay to bet on a truce, not a forecast of one.
poly-us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-by-no.recent: Mediation in Islamabad had Iran shortening its Hormuz reopening plan from 7 days to 2, but the next day brought a third Iranian drone attack on Bahrain in a week, aimed at a US radar at Isa air base, Iran's claim that mines hit four tankers in 24 hours, and Trump in Manila taking a reported dirty-bomb plot against Washington 'very seriously'.

stocks:UPS.standing: United Parcel Service, the Atlanta-based carrier that moves parcels by truck and by its own cargo airline, hubbed at Louisville. Its volumes track consumer spending and online shopping, and its costs track fuel and labour contracts.

stocks:HMC.standing: Honda's American depositary shares on the New York Stock Exchange, priced in dollars. The Tokyo company is the world's largest motorcycle maker and a major carmaker, so the yen and US tariffs on Japanese cars both reach this price.
stocks:HMC.recent: Honda reported profit up 66%, carried by its motorcycles while its car business still lost money. That result landed after the chart's last close, so it does not account for the move within it.

poly-will-no-second-mandate-to-form-a-go.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the first lawmaker Israel's president asks to form a government after the 2026 vote succeeds, so that no second candidate is handed the mandate. Each failed round brings Israel closer to another election.
poly-will-no-second-mandate-to-form-a-go.recent: 67 lawmakers recommended Eisenkot to form the government against 46 for Netanyahu, yet Eisenkot then opened unity talks with the man he says must go. The bloc behind him came under more strain when police arrested 3 Arab-party members on unfounded information and the opposition called the arrests a coup.

stocks:COL.AX.standing: Coles Group runs one of Australia's two dominant supermarket chains, alongside Woolworths, plus liquor stores such as Liquorland. Its shares trade on food inflation, wage costs and regulators' scrutiny of grocery pricing.
stocks:COL.AX.recent: The one story about Coles was its disclosure of a cyber attack, made without saying what happened. That disclosure came after this window closed, so it does not account for the slide.

stocks:WOW.AX.standing: Australia's largest supermarket chain, which also owns the Big W discount stores and the New Zealand Countdown grocery network. Its prices and margins sit at the centre of the country's long-running argument over the cost of food.

stocks:000660.KS.standing: South Korea's second-largest memory-chip maker after Samsung, and the leading supplier of the high-bandwidth memory stacked beside Nvidia's AI processors. Its share price is a read on how much the AI build-out is spending.
stocks:000660.KS.recent: The fortnight's news on SK Hynix was about building: crews working 24/7 on its first fab at Yongin, a plant set to stand 150 metres tall, and a $1 billion fund with a testing hub for smaller Korean chip suppliers. None of it explains the fall in the share.

stocks:AMZN.standing: The world's largest online retailer and, through Amazon Web Services, the biggest seller of cloud computing. AWS earns most of the company's operating profit, so the share moves on cloud demand as much as on shopping.
stocks:AMZN.recent: Nothing reported over these weeks explains the rise. The blow to Amazon's own business came after the last close shown: a United Launch Alliance Vulcan failed 10 minutes after liftoff from Cape Canaveral and destroyed 40 Amazon Leo satellites. The constellation, its answer to Starlink, depends on scarce non-SpaceX launches and faces an FCC deployment deadline.

stocks:DBK.DE.standing: Shares of Germany's largest lender, listed in Frankfurt and run with a large investment-banking arm. The price tracks European interest rates, trading income and the bank's legal and credit costs.
stocks:DBK.DE.recent: The shares fell after an international media consortium published more than 15 million leaked files detailing years of compliance failures. The bank kept about 28,000 flagged clients, and a May 2020 memo tied two Trump companies to money-laundering schemes.

stocks:CBK.DE.standing: Germany's second-largest listed bank, based in Frankfurt and a main lender to the Mittelstand, the mid-sized firms behind German exports. The German state has held a stake in it since rescuing it in the 2008 crisis.
stocks:CBK.DE.recent: UniCredit's €45 billion bid for the bank won unconditional EU approval, after the US Fed had also approved. Competition chief Teresa Ribera warned that Brussels will intervene if Berlin tries to block it. It is the first big cross-border bank merger the EU's banking union was built to allow.

poly-will-anthropics-valuation-hit-high-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, is valued at $1.75 trillion or more by year's end. Funding rounds and share sales set that valuation, so the price moves on news of either.

stocks:JPM.standing: America's largest bank by assets, joining the Chase consumer bank to one of Wall Street's biggest investment banks. Its shares are read as a gauge of US credit, consumer spending and dealmaking.
stocks:JPM.recent: A software bug took Chase offline on Monday: nearly 5,000 customers reported outages to Downdetector and Zelle transfers stalled, the third disruption in a week. The same day JPMorgan linked its blockchain deposit network with DBS for 24/7 dollar transfers. Both came at the window's end, and neither accounts for the earlier swing.

poly-will-jensen-huang-rejoin-nvidia-by-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Jensen Huang, who co-founded NVIDIA and ran it as chief executive for three decades, returns to the company before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders pay for a yes.

poly-predictfun-fdv-above-2b-one-day-aft.standing: A bet on whether the token of Predict.fun, a crypto prediction-market platform, is valued above $2 billion the day after it lists, counting every token that will ever exist rather than only those trading.
poly-predictfun-fdv-above-2b-one-day-aft.recent: The fortnight's news about prediction markets centred on Trump Jr.'s firm putting $300 million into Polymarket and his exit as an adviser to its rival Kalshi. None of it concerned Predict.fun or its launch, and none of it accounts for the price.

wiki-israel.standing: How many people read Wikipedia's article on Israel each day. It rises when a war, an election or a break with an ally sends readers who do not follow the region looking for the country itself.
wiki-israel.recent: After the election, 67 lawmakers recommended Eisenkot to form a government and 46 recommended Netanyahu, who now presses for a unity coalition with the Haredim that Eisenkot calls spin. The opposition called police arrests of 3 Arab-party members a coup, and Britain froze the assets of 8 Israeli settlement builders.

poly-will-predictfun-launch-a-token-by-n.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Predict.fun, a crypto prediction-market platform, launches its own token by Nov 30, 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it trades on airdrop and launch rumours.
poly-will-predictfun-launch-a-token-by-n.recent: The fortnight's reporting on prediction markets centred on Trump Jr. leaving his advisory role at Kalshi after his firm put $300 million into its rival Polymarket. Nothing in it concerns Predict.fun or its token, and none of it accounts for this contract's price.

stocks:AVIO.MI.standing: Avio builds Europe's Vega small-satellite rockets and the solid-fuel boosters that lift Ariane 6, from its works at Colleferro near Rome. It is the continent's main alternative to buying launches from SpaceX.
stocks:AVIO.MI.recent: Early in the month Avio scaled back a demonstrator programme over technical challenges. Then ICEYE bid €41 a share, a 21.3% premium and €2.05 billion in all, and pledged €1 billion more of investment in Italy. The Finnish radar-satellite operator wants its own launcher, and the Italian state, which holds a stake in Avio, has a golden-power veto over the sale.

wiki-artificial-intelligence.standing: The English Wikipedia article on artificial intelligence: software that learns from data to reason, write, see and act. How many open it each day shows how far the subject reaches beyond the people building it.
wiki-artificial-intelligence.recent: The early-November spike came with a rout in AI stocks that spread to Asia. South Korea halted trading after the Kospi fell 8%, and copper hit its lowest since July on AI fears. The same day OpenAI said GPT-6 Cyber had found 948 Linux flaws.

poly-us-announces-end-of-iranian-blockad.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States lifts its naval blockade of Iran by 30 November 2026. The blockade sets how much Iranian oil reaches buyers and how freely tankers move through the Gulf.
poly-us-announces-end-of-iranian-blockad.recent: The Gulf escalated instead of calming. A third US carrier arrived, putting 3 carriers and 13 destroyers opposite Iran. The IRGC sent drones at a US radar at Isa air base in Bahrain, and Iran said mines hit 4 tankers in 24 hours. Tehran shortened its Hormuz reopening plan from 7 days to 2 in Islamabad, and that did not offset the strikes.

stocks:UBER.standing: The largest ride-hailing and food-delivery platform outside China, taking a cut of each fare its drivers and couriers carry. Its margins rest on how regulators let it classify and pay those workers.
stocks:UBER.recent: The news about Uber's own business in the window was its exit from Nigeria and a third-party breach it said touched nearly 150,000 people. The breach was disclosed after the latest close, and neither story accounts for the price.

poly-will-anthropics-ipo-valuation-be-be.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, goes public at a valuation between $1.25 trillion and $1.50 trillion. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

poly-variational-fdv-above-1b-one-day-af.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Variational's token, once launched, is valued above $1 billion fully diluted a day later. FDV prices every token that will ever exist, not just those trading, so it is how crypto launches are sized.

stocks:AAPL.standing: Shares of Apple, the Cupertino maker of the iPhone, the Mac and a large paid-services business, and one of the most valuable companies listed on the Nasdaq. The iPhone still brings in about half of its revenue.
stocks:AAPL.recent: Apple's own news was operational rather than financial: Siri in China launched running on Alibaba's Qwen, Thai officials met Apple over spyware alerts sent to politicians, and Apple said an internal update caused the outage that took its services down. None of it accounts for the share price.

poly-will-raphael-warnock-win-the-2028-d.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Raphael Warnock, Georgia's Democratic senator and pastor of Atlanta's Ebenezer Baptist Church, becomes his party's 2028 presidential nominee. Its price is what traders pay for that.

wiki-unmanned-aerial-vehicle.standing: An aircraft flown with no pilot aboard, steered remotely or by onboard software. Cheap enough to launch in swarms, drones have become a main weapon against refineries, power grids and military bases.
wiki-unmanned-aerial-vehicle.recent: Drones were the strike weapon on three fronts at once. Ukraine sent them against the Kirishi and Ryazan refineries and the Kerch Bridge to Crimea; in Sudan they hit power stations and cut water supplies; and Iran launched them at U.S. bases in Bahrain while claiming it downed an Orbiter 4 over Nahavand.

poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the Federal Reserve raises its policy rate by a quarter point at its January 2027 meeting. Traders pay for that outcome, and the price reprices with each US inflation print and Fed speech.
poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.recent: October's prices turned the bet: core consumer prices rose 0.3%, and the Fed's Logan called for two more hikes, possibly rapidly. Two-year Treasury yields jumped on half-point hike fears, Deutsche Bank now sees 3 straight Fed hikes, and Musalem says several are likely needed by spring.

stocks:CVX.standing: One of the two largest US oil companies, pumping crude and gas from the Permian Basin to Kazakhstan and Australia's LNG plants and refining it into fuel. Its share price tracks oil prices and its spending on new supply.

stocks:XOM.standing: The largest US oil and gas company, pumping crude and natural gas worldwide and refining it into fuels and chemicals. Its shares move with the oil price and with refining margins.

stocks:TTE.standing: France's largest energy company, producing oil and gas worldwide and ranking among the biggest traders of liquefied natural gas, with a growing power and renewables arm. This series is its New York listing, priced in dollars.

poly-will-douard-philippe-win-the-2027-f.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Édouard Philippe, Emmanuel Macron's prime minister from 2020 to 2022 and founder of the Horizons party, wins France's 2027 presidential election, the first Macron cannot contest.

poly-will-jensen-huang-publicly-testify-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Jensen Huang, Nvidia's chief executive, appears before a US congressional committee to give testimony before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for a yes.
poly-will-jensen-huang-publicly-testify-.recent: The fortnight's prediction-market news was about the venues themselves: Trump Jr. left Kalshi after his firm put $300 million into Polymarket. None of it concerns Huang or a hearing, and nothing in the input explains why bettors moved on this contract.

stocks:VALE.standing: Brazil's largest miner and one of the world's biggest iron ore producers, also mining nickel and copper. Its shares trade in New York and follow Chinese steel demand, the main buyer of its ore.

poly-iran-leadership-change-by-december-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Iran's top leadership changes before the year ends. Its price is what traders will stake on the Islamic Republic's ruling order breaking under war, sanctions and unrest.
poly-iran-leadership-change-by-december-.recent: Nothing in the fortnight touched who rules Tehran. Iran's Guard claimed mines hit tankers in Hormuz, Iran sent drones at a US radar in Bahrain and shortened its Hormuz reopening plan through mediation in Islamabad, and in Washington Vance blamed the Iran war for the midterm defeat. None of it accounts for the price.

stocks:BRKM5.SA.standing: Brazil's largest petrochemical company and the biggest maker of thermoplastic resins in the Americas, controlled jointly by Novonor and Petrobras. Its profits ride the spread between naphtha feedstock and plastic resin prices.

poly-houthis-enter-aden-by-december-31-2.standing: A Polymarket contract paying out if Houthi forces enter Aden, the southern port where Yemen's internationally recognised government sits, by the end of 2026. Its price is what traders bet on the war's front reaching the south.
poly-houthis-enter-aden-by-december-31-2.recent: Houthi missiles damaged Aramco Tower in Riyadh and struck Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline, and Saudi-led strikes answered on Sanaa, Hodeidah and Saada. What bears on Aden is the ground war: Yemen government forces withdrew from an area near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, leaving the Houthis in control, and the Houthis freed 600 fighters as those forces redeployed.

poly-will-crude-oil-reach-a-new-all-time.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if crude oil sets a new record price before March 2027. The nominal high still dates from the July 2008 spike, so the contract is a bet on a supply shock large enough to beat it.

poly-predictfun-fdv-above-400m-one-day-a.standing: A bet on whether Predict.fun, a prediction-market platform, will carry a fully diluted valuation above $400M the day after its token launches. That valuation prices every token that will ever exist, not just those trading.
poly-predictfun-fdv-above-400m-one-day-a.recent: The fortnight's prediction-market news centred on Kalshi and Polymarket: Trump Jr. left Kalshi after his firm invested $300 million in its rival Polymarket. None of it concerned Predict.fun or its token, and none of it accounts for this price.

poly-will-jon-ossoff-win-the-2028-us-pre.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Jon Ossoff, the Georgia Democrat, wins the 2028 US presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves as the party's field takes shape.
poly-will-jon-ossoff-win-the-2028-us-pre.recent: The contract rose in the days after a midterm that Axios called a blue tsunami that broke MAGA. JD Vance blamed the Iran war for Trump's crushing defeat and clashed with him in public over it. None of the reporting from those days names Ossoff himself.

poly-will-anthropic-announce-bankruptcy-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab that makes the Claude models, goes bankrupt before the end of 2027. It prices the risk that a cash-hungry frontier lab runs out of money before its revenue catches up.
poly-will-anthropic-announce-bankruptcy-.recent: Nothing in the reporting of these weeks concerned Anthropic's finances. The news about this market was about Polymarket itself: Trump Jr.'s firm invested $300 million in it, and he left his advisory role at its rival Kalshi. None of that accounts for the price.

wiki-european-central-bank.standing: Daily readers of Wikipedia's article on the European Central Bank, the Frankfurt institution that sets interest rates for every country using the euro and supervises its largest banks.
wiki-european-central-bank.recent: Christine Lagarde leaves on 7 February, and the field to replace her narrowed to Knot and De Cos. Berlin sealed it: Spain takes the presidency and Germany the chief economist's seat for Markus Brunnermeier, a post Paris ceded after Germany's chancellor and finance minister had rejected each other's candidates.

wiki-bitcoin.standing: How many people read Wikipedia's article on Bitcoin each day. Bitcoin is the first and largest cryptocurrency, and the article's readership surges when its price swings or when governments move to regulate it.
wiki-bitcoin.recent: The early-November spike came as a Democratic sweep in Congress left the CLARITY Act stalled 49 to 50 in the Senate. The slide that followed took bitcoin below $70,000. Spot bitcoin ETFs lost a net $1.282 billion in a week, and MSCI dropped Strategy, owner of 850,364 bitcoin, from its indexes.

stocks:TTWO.standing: The New York video game publisher that owns Rockstar Games and 2K, behind Grand Theft Auto, Red Dead Redemption and NBA 2K, plus Zynga's mobile titles. Its share price turns on the timing and sales of a few blockbuster releases.
stocks:TTWO.recent: The news around Take-Two centred on the release of Grand Theft Auto VI, which one Chennai company marked by giving its staff the day off, and on Rockstar firing 31 unionising UK staff before the launch. Neither story accounts for the share price.
